title: Le Col announces unmissable Black Friday deals
content:
Cyclist
Le Col announces unmissable Black Friday deals

Not content with offering some of the world’s best performance-driven cycling apparel, Le Col is currently offering up to 60% off selected premium riding kit, with even bigger savings over the Black Friday weekend. Here, we’ve curated some of the best deals you can snap up between now and the final weekend of November.

And – as if you needed another reason to move quickly – the British-born performance brand is offering free UK delivery on orders of more than £130. Plus, on Cyber Monday (November 30), there’s a free gift with orders over £150 (see bottom for details). There really is no better time of the year to stock up on new kit, is there?

Also, by bagging a Le Col bargain, you’ll ensure every winter ride (whether rapid or easy) is warm, dry, comfortable and, just as importantly, performed in high-quality performance gear that’s developed with quality, style, and durability at its heart.

Men’s Pro Bib Shorts (grey/white): WAS £220 | NOW £90

If your rides are all about top speed and marginal gains, these are the shorts for you. They’re designed for maximum aero efficiency, and feature a compressive fit and top-end moisture wicking qualities. Everything about them is aimed at reducing bulk and boosting performance, right down to the all-new chamois – 6g lighter than previous incarnations, with antibacterial Silver Dry fabric (which also offers better breathability) and hydrophobic foam (which holds less moisture). Even the upper construction is improved, with enhanced ventilation.

Buy the Le Col Men’s Pro Bib Shorts

Men’s Pro Thermal Bib Shorts (navy/black): WAS £220 | NOW £135

The ideal piece of kit for transitional days. Not cold enough for tights? Pull these on – they feature soft, thermal material to retain heat in your legs, a DWR treatment to deliver premium protection from showers and road spray, and a race fit to optimise aerodynamics. Not cold enough for tights, but too cold for just shorts? Pair these with a pair of leg warmers, and you have a versatile set-up to see you through late autumn and early spring.

Buy the Le Col Men’s Pro Thermal Bib Shorts

Men’s Pro Long Sleeve Thermology: WAS £170 | NOW £120

A no-compromise, aero performance jersey that not only looks stunning but also shields you from the elements. Developed with pro rider feedback and wind tunnel testing, it’s designed for high-tempo rides, and combines lightweight insulation (thanks to a brushed inner fabric) with exceptional wicking qualities. Its compressive stretch fabric moves naturally with the body, allowing an aggressive riding position without compromising on comfort. There are three rear pockets, plus a fourth, waterproof compartment.

Buy the Le Col Men’s Pro Long Sleeve Thermology

Men’s Pro Jacket: WAS £275 | NOW £110

True performance winter kit with speed at its heart, this race-fit jacket pairs breathability with weather protection, allowing you to pour everything into the ride in comfort, no matter what the weather. Polartec Power Shield fabric fights off wind and rain, and offers exceptional moisture wicking. A bonded front hem keeps the jacket anchored, scuba cuffs block cold air and spray, and a Vision Aquaguard zip further eliminates moisture ingress. Reflective details even add a dash of visibility for the darker months.

Buy the Le Col Men’s Pro Jacket

Women’s Hors Categorie Bib Tights: WAS £260 | NOW £145

These bib tights are engineered for long winter miles in less than favourable conditions, and are cut with a female-specific fit. Protection comes from a three-layer membrane to keep drizzle, spray and wind at bay. Insulation from a soft Italian Roubaix fleece lining is also bolstered by breathability. And the female-specific chamois takes comfort to new heights, with high-density foam construction for improved support, plus anti-bacterial Ionic+ tech for better moisture management.

Buy the Le Col Women’s Hors Category Bib Tights

Women’s Deep Winter Base Layer: WAS £80 | NOW £60

Perhaps the most essential weapon in the winter rider’s arsenal, this high-tech, lightweight, long-sleeved base layer not only insulates but also boasts remarkable temperature regulation, thanks to Polartec Alpha fabric at the core and upper back. Polartec Power Grid fabric on the lower back and arms uses a geometric structure to trap that heat in the first place, while also promoting airflow to wick away moisture. All in all, this base layer is a one-way ticket to training hard in comfort.

Buy the Le Col Women’s Deep Winter Base Layer

Women’s Pro Aqua Zero Long Sleeve Jersey: WAS £180 | NOW £75

The ultimate three-season jersey, designed to protect from the cold and rain while regulating your temperature, so all you need to focus on is your efforts. Thermal brushed fabric provides the insulation, and a tightly woven, stretch outer keeps the elements at bay, offering a water-repellent coating to shake off showers and spray. This is the piece of kit you’ll always reach for, whether your plan is autumn/winter base miles or spring tempo sessions.

Buy the Le Col Women’s Pro Aqua Zero Long Sleeve Jersey

• Shop the Le Col Black Friday sale now at lecol.cc

Exclusive until 1st December only:

Any new customers spending £150 with Le Col can add the Unisex Sleeveless Layer to their basket and enter code AFF-BFBLFREE at checkout to get it completely FREE! Offer applies to new customers only.
